annotations.title: Federal and other official places to look, by type

description: Federal and other official places to look, by type. For requests like "how do I find an old 401k?", "unclaimed tax refund", "lost savings bonds", "money from a failed bank", "FTC refund", "my mum died, did she leave money or life insurance?", "find my old pension" (UK with country=GB), "find my Child Trust Fund". Without a type, returns every source.

country.description: Two-letter country code. GB (or UK) gives the UK tracing services. Defaults to the caller's country, else US.

type.description: Type: tax, retirement, bonds, banks, investments, refunds, insurance, deceased, wages, courts, tribal or all. Everyday words like 401k, pension, stocks or "my dad died" also work; UK words like HMRC, Premium Bonds or Child Trust Fund give the UK answer.
